note: Micon submodule: one field widget `micon_linkit_attributes` (label 'Linkit (with icon and attributes)') for the core `link` field type, extending linkit_attributes' LinkitWithAttributesWidget + micon_link's MiconLinkWidgetTrait. Requires contrib linkit, link_attributes (linkit_attributes), and micon_link. Icon stored at options.attributes.data-icon; reuses packages/icon/position settings but drops `target` (linkit_attributes handles it). No formatter/settings form/route. Medium reads a link field's widget id; hard switches a link field's form-display widget to micon_linkit_attributes. Grounded in the core.entity_form_display component type.

evals.prompt: Which field widget does micon_linkit_attributes add and for which field type?
evals.expected_output: The micon_linkit_attributes widget ('Linkit (with icon and attributes)') for the core `link` field type; enable it on Manage form display.

evals.prompt: What three capabilities does the micon_linkit_attributes widget combine, and which modules must be enabled?
evals.expected_output: Linkit autocomplete + Link Attributes controls + Micon icon picker; requires contrib linkit, link_attributes (linkit_attributes) and micon_link (extends LinkitWithAttributesWidget + MiconLinkWidgetTrait).

evals.prompt: Compared to the micon_link/micon_linkit widgets, which Micon widget setting does micon_linkit_attributes deliberately omit, and why?
evals.expected_output: It drops the Micon `target` (open in new window) setting because the linkit_attributes widget already provides target/attribute handling.

evals.prompt: On this site the Article content type has a Link field field_micon_lka_med. Inspect the live default form display and report which widget it uses.
evals.expected_output: It uses the micon_linkit_attributes widget, per core.entity_form_display.node.article.default component field_micon_lka_med (type: micon_linkit_attributes).

evals.prompt: On this site the Article content type has a Link field field_micon_lka_task using the plain core link widget. Using micon_linkit_attributes, switch that field's form-display widget to the Micon Linkit Attributes widget (micon_linkit_attributes) and apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: In core.entity_form_display.node.article.default the field_micon_lka_task component has widget type micon_linkit_attributes.
